{{for multi|the rugby player|Jeremy Richardson (rugby union)|the Grenadian footballer|Jeremy Richardson (footballer)}}
'''Jeremy Terrell Richardson''' (born March 1, 1984) is an American former professional [[basketball player]]. He is a 6'7", 210 lb. [[swingman]] who played in the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA) with the [[Atlanta Hawks]], [[Portland Trail Blazers]], [[Memphis Grizzlies]], [[San Antonio Spurs]] and [[Orlando Magic]].

== College career ==
Richardson was born in [[Alsen, Louisiana]] and graduated from [[Zachary High School]] in Louisiana in 2002.<ref name="NBDL bio">{{cite web|title=Jeremy Richardson college stats|url=http://www.nba.com/media/dleague/jeremy_richardson.pdf|publisher=NBA D-League|year=2006|accessdate=June 19, 2011|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121111023417/http://www.nba.com/media/dleague/jeremy_richardson.pdf|archive-date=November 11, 2012|url-status=dead}}</ref> Prior to entering the NBA, he attended [[Copiah-Lincoln Community College]] for two years and transferred to the [[NCAA Division II]] [[Delta State University]].<ref name="ESPN DB">{{cite web|title=Jeremy Richardson |url=http://espndb.go.com/nba/finals/profile/_/id/3160/type/player/profile?id=703&type=player |publisher=ESPNDB |accessdate=June 19, 2011 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20110815201212/http://espndb.go.com/nba/finals/profile/_/id/3160/type/player/profile?id=703&type=player |archivedate=August 15, 2011 }}</ref>

== Professional career ==
Richardson was selected with the ninth pick of the second round in the 2006 [[NBA Development League|NBA D-League]] Draft by the [[Fort Worth Flyers]]. On January 27, 2007, he was signed to a ten-day contract by the Atlanta Hawks. Previously playing for the Flyers, it was the seventh call-up from the D-League during the [[2006–07 NBA season|2006–07 season]].<ref>[http://www.oursportscentral.com/services/releases/?id=3420281 Hawks Sign Flyers Richardson to 10-Day Contract]</ref> After his second 10-day contract<ref>[http://www.realgm.com/src_wiretap_archives/44599/19691231/hawks_sign_jeremy_richardson_to_second_10_day/ Hawks Sign Jeremy Richardson To Second 10-Day] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080403061444/http://www.realgm.com/src_wiretap_archives/44599/19691231/hawks_sign_jeremy_richardson_to_second_10_day/ |date=2008-04-03 }}
</ref> expired, the Hawks opted not to retain him.

In March 2007, he was signed to a 10-day contract by the [[Portland Trail Blazers]].<ref>[http://www.nba.com/blazers/news/Trail_Blazers_sign_Jeremy_Rich-213579-1218.html Trail Blazers sign Jeremy Richardson to 10-Day contract]</ref>  At the end of the contract, the Blazers cut him; he played in one game for them.<ref>[http://timesheraldonline.com/ci_5417654 Blazers rout Golden State] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070927202233/http://timesheraldonline.com/ci_5417654 |date=2007-09-27 }}, March 12, 2007</ref> Richardson returned to the Flyers afterwards.

Richardson was selected in the first round (second overall) of the 2007 D-League [[expansion draft]] by the [[Fort Wayne Mad Ants]].<ref name=performeroftheweek>[http://www.oursportscentral.com/services/releases/?id=3566629 Jeremy Richardson Named D-League.Com Performer of the Week]. December 4, 2007</ref>

Richardson spent the [[2007-08 NBA season|2007-08]] NBA preseason with the [[Miami Heat]] but was waived on October 29, 2007.<ref name=spurs/> On December 20, 2007, he was signed by the [[Memphis Grizzlies]].<ref name=spurs/><ref>[http://www.oursportscentral.com/services/releases/?id=3572312 Memphis Grizzlies Sign Jeremy Richardson of the Fort Wayne Mad Ants]. December 20, 2007</ref> Until then he was averaging 28.5 points, 6.6 rebounds, 1.8 assists and 1.63 steals<ref name=spurs/> in 41.5 minutes in eight games for the Mad Ants. He was named D-League.com Performer of the Week, after averaging 35 points, 6.5 rebounds, and 4.0 assists in two games during the week of December 3, shooting 53.2% from the field (25/47), including scoring a league season-high 40 points against the [[Iowa Energy]] on November 29.<ref name=performeroftheweek/> He was waived on January 7, and signed three days later with the [[San Antonio Spurs]].<ref name=spurs>[http://www.nba.com/spurs/news/richardson_signed_080110.html Spurs Sign Jeremy Richardson], January 10, 2008</ref>

{{wikinews|NBA holds second annual NBDL All-Star game}} 
In 2008, Richardson was named MVP of the [[NBA Development League All-Star Game|D-League All Star Game]], scoring 22 points on 9/15 shooting. Shortly afterwards, he was signed to another 10-day contract by the Atlanta Hawks. Richardson in the 2008 offseason was signed by the [[Orlando Magic]]. On December 8 he received a 3.5 million dollar bonus.

In August 2009, he joined the [[A1 Ethniki|Greek League]] club [[Aris BC|Aris Thessaloniki]]<ref>[http://www.arisbc.gr/index.php?SCREEN=page&PageID=2153&LangID=1 Arisbc.gr Στον ΑΡΗ ο Jeremy Richardson {{in lang|el}}]</ref> where he averaged 12.2 points and 3.3 rebounds per game. In September 2010 he signed a one-year contract with the [[Spain|Spanish]] club [[Valencia BC|Power Electronics Valencia]].<ref>[http://www.euroleague.net/euroleaguenews/transactions/2010-11-signings/i/75377/4465/power-electronics-adds-richardson POWER ELECTRONICS adds Richardson]</ref>

In August 2011, he signed with [[BC Armia]] in Georgia.<ref>[http://basketball.realgm.com/wiretap/215334/Jeremy_Richardson_Signs_With_BC_Armia Jeremy Richardson Signs With BC Armia]</ref> In August 2012, he joined [[Sidigas Avellino]] in Italy.<ref>[http://www.sportando.com/en/italy/serie-a/94119/avellino-officially-signs-jeremy-richardson.html Avellino officially signs Jeremy Richardson]</ref> In September 2013, he re-signed with Avellino for one more season.<ref>[http://www.sportando.com/en/italy/serie-a/105667/sidigas-avellino-officially-re-signs-jeremy-richardson.html Sidigas Avellino officially re-signs Jeremy Richardson]</ref>

In July 2014, he signed a one-year deal with [[New Basket Brindisi|Enel Brindisi]].<ref>[http://www.newbasketbrindisi.it/nbb/portale/news/5123/arriva-jeremy-terrell-richardson Arriva Jeremy Terrell Richardson!] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140714225559/http://www.newbasketbrindisi.it/nbb/portale/news/5123/arriva-jeremy-terrell-richardson |date=July 14, 2014 }} {{in lang|it}}</ref> He parted ways with club before the start of the new season, because of personal reasons.<ref>[http://www.sportando.com/en/italy/serie-a/132494/brindisi-in-troubles-jeremy-richardson-won-t-join-the-team.html Brindisi in troubles: Jeremy Richardson won't join the team]</ref><ref>[http://www.sportando.com/en/italy/serie-a/132585/enel-brindisi-lands-dejan-ivanov-and-demonte-harper.html Enel Brindisi lands Dejan Ivanov and Demonte Harper]</ref>
